$description: Closed asset-role registry built from real usage sites in src/ and public/. A generator may not invent a role. The source is a real, live company (Foreplay, foreplay.co): brand, product imagery, customer logos and people's photos belong to Foreplay or third parties.

generationPolicyMeaning.may-generate-new: New non-identifying decorative assets may be generated.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-reuse-exact: Only the exact existing file may be referenced; no redraws.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-fabricate: Never generate, alter or invent; generated pages use placeholder refs.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: Never copy a live third-party URL/token; render a placeholder.

generatedInstanceRefEnum.file-or-placeholder: ref may be placeholder:... or file:/<existing public path>

globalProhibitions: Do not reproduce real logos (Foreplay's, customers', partners', sponsors', competitors', stores', AI vendors') by redrawing, tracing or generating them.
Do not generate, edit or substitute photos of real people, and do not fabricate names, titles or quotes attributed to real people.
Do not reproduce Foreplay's proprietary content (product UI, footage, blog covers, copy) as newly generated material presented as real.
Do not copy live third-party endpoints, widget ids or tokens; the clone makes no third-party requests.
Do not publish generated pages: this repository is for local/internal use only.

pinnedRoles.$note: Compliance-critical roles and the exact policy each must carry; verify_all.py and semantic_validate.py check these pinned values, not just enum membership.

brand-mark.description: Foreplay's own logos/wordmarks (navbar/footer logo, fireside + university logos, media-kit folder, agency wordmark).
brand-mark.licensingGuidance: Foreplay trademark (a real, live company). Reference the existing file only; never redraw, recolour, re-proportion or generate a look-alike.

product-icon.description: Foreplay product icons: isometric product renders, animated icon videos, pi-*-hq sprites/webps.
product-icon.licensingGuidance: Proprietary product identity; reuse the exact file, never generate new product icons.

product-screenshot.description: Real Foreplay UI captures, mockups, report screens, board images.
product-screenshot.licensingGuidance: Real proprietary product UI. Generated pages must use a placeholder ref; never generate fake UI presented as the real product.

product-video.description: Product demo/loop videos (hero video, product previews, cta-*.mov/webm).
product-video.licensingGuidance: Real proprietary footage; placeholder only in generated pages.

customer-logo.description: Real customer/partner/sponsor brand marks: logo strip, logo rain bodies, work-with logo grid, industry carousels, contest sponsors, testimonial company logos.
customer-logo.licensingGuidance: Third-party trademarks. Never reproduce, trace, redraw or generate real logos; generated pages use neutral placeholder refs only.

third-party-mark.description: Other companies' marks used factually: Chrome, G2, Capterra, App Store/Google Play badges, AI-vendor and integration icons, competitor logos on comparison pages.
third-party-mark.licensingGuidance: Third-party trademarks; placeholder refs only in generated pages.

person-portrait.description: Photos of real people: testimonial headshots, expert/author/speaker avatars, calendar host, bounty and contest headshots.
person-portrait.licensingGuidance: Real people's likeness. Never generate, edit or substitute photos of real people, and never pair a real name/quote with a generated face. Generated pages use placeholder refs and placeholder names (personIdentity fields).

editorial-image.description: Blog covers, card images, event thumbnails, contest thumbs, affiliate/fireside step images.
editorial-image.licensingGuidance: Proprietary editorial content of a real company; placeholder only.

decorative-media.description: Non-identifying decoration: dot grid, glows, rays, abstract illustrations, background loops.
decorative-media.licensingGuidance: May be newly generated if it contains no logo, person, product UI or text.

ui-icon.description: Generic interface glyphs (chevrons, calendar, check/x, play, card head icons).

lottie-animation.description: Lottie JSON animations (feature cards, chrome-extension pin, loaders).

third-party-embed.description: Third-party embeds rendered as same-size placeholders: YouTube, Wistia, Cal.com, Senja, NoteForms, X, Luma, reCAPTCHA/Turnstile, Elfsight, Unicorn Studio.
third-party-embed.licensingGuidance: No third-party request may be made. Never copy live embed URLs, widget ids or tokens; use EmbedPlaceholder with a placeholder ref.
